---
title: "Arizona Cardinals Season Analysis"
format: html
---

```{python}
import polars as pl
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```

```{python}
card_seasons = pl.read_csv("cardinals_seasons.csv")
```

```{python}
modern_seasons = card_seasons.filter(pl.col("season") >= 1978)

best_seasons = modern_seasons.sort("win_pct", descending=True).head(5)
best_seasons
```

```{python}
worst_seasons = modern_seasons.sort("win_pct").head(5)
worst_seasons
```

```{python}
era_summary = (
    card_seasons
    .group_by("era")
    .agg(
        pl.col("win_pct").mean().alias("avg_win_pct"),
        pl.col("season").count().alias("num_seasons"),
        pl.col("made_playoffs").sum().alias("playoff_appearances"),
    )
    .sort("avg_win_pct", descending=True)
)
era_summary
```

```{python}
(
    ggplot(card_seasons.to_pandas(), aes(x="season", y="win_pct", color="era"))
    + geom_line()
    + geom_point()
    + scale_x_continuous(format="d")
    + ggtitle("Cardinals Win Percentage by Season")
    + xlab("Season")
    + ylab("Win Percentage")
)
```
